raw_text: Shipping industry sources confirm Mumbai Port operations severely disrupted by cyber attack. Vessel traffic management and cargo scheduling systems offline. Ships being diverted to JNPT creating congestion. Legacy SCADA system vulnerability was the entry point. Port workers report all container tracking systems are down. Recovery timeline unclear.
clean_text: Mumbai Port operations severely disrupted. Vessel and cargo systems offline, ships diverted to JNPT. Legacy SCADA vulnerability exploited. Container tracking down.
